nora: Running the quarterly recurrence hypothesis triage. Scan found 18 recurrences across signatures P-Alpha, P-Beta, P-Gamma. This thread: lock owners, acceptance criteria, and realistic timelines.

ben: I'll own P-Beta short-term mitigation (circuit + alert tuning). Can do ETA 5 business days.

rachel: I'll take P-Gamma long-term redesign. Need 6 weeks for design + rollout.

omar: Taking P-Alpha but blocked on CAP-9002 (node replacements). Filed CAP-9002. If capacity stalls, fallback is routing split + reduced batch size.

incident-bot: Auto-summary: pattern-scan 2026-04-02; recurrences=18; created follow-ups: PM-1204..PM-1206. Template: owner | ticket | ETA | AC | fallback.

nora: Ben, please include the quick mitigation commands and monitoring query in the tracker. Example AC: "<=2 recurrences in 30d and no customer-facing 5xx for 14d".

ben: Staging mitigation commands I used:

```
rgctl routes update --route router-main --circuit 75 --window 60
curl -s -X POST https://ops.redwood/api/models/pin -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"beta-v2"}'
```

ben: Staging 6h smoke: 0 recurrences. I'll run 24h tonight. Posting logs to tracker on success.

rachel: Drafting long-term plan for P-Gamma with canary + automated fallback. Will post design doc link by EOD Friday.

omar: Capacity replied: CAP-9002 pending approval, ETA Tue EOD. If delayed, I'll proceed with routing split fallback and document expected latency impact.

ben: I'll post weekly Friday check-ins and update the tracker: <https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/INC-TRACKER>.
